name: digital-universe
vibe: A prompt-to-video launch film set INSIDE a data-cosmos — you are inside a computer, not looking at a starry sky. A persistent data-space backdrop flows unbroken across every cut: a particle depth field flying toward the camera, faint network connecting-lines strung between the nearest particles, a receding dotted 3D data-grid corridor (floor + ceiling) converging to a central vanishing point, and two soft accent data-nebula glows. Over it: kinetic gradient headlines that pop word-by-word, glowing screenshot data-panel device-frames with HUD corner brackets and a scan-line, a forming data-core, converging data streams and a logo-reveal CTA. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole universe — particles, grid, network lines, panels, chips and CTA, not just the text. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for AI/tech products, data platforms, developer tools, app launches and anything that should feel deep, systematic and future-facing.
